summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc furnished a routine Form 6-K listing UK FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules items for October 2026: three PDMR shareholding notices and a Total Voting Rights and Capital announcement. The PDMR notices report small Employee Share Purchase Plan acquisitions of 4.855860 ordinary shares each at USD 104.5062 (aggregate USD 507.47) on Nasdaq on 2026-10-12 by Juan de Rueda Gamboa, Ana Callol and Jose Antonio Echeverria. No corporate transaction, stake, board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock is involved. No special-situation or risk-arb angle; purely administrative disclosure.
